description: A finite list is a valid omega normal form evaluating to a if and only if it is CNF omega a.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.OrdinalPowers.normalForm_characterization.{u} (a : Ordinal.{u})
  (l : List (Ordinal.{u} × Ordinal.{u})) :
  Lemmatheca.SetTheory.OrdinalPowers.IsNormalForm l ∧ Lemmatheca.SetTheory.OrdinalPowers.evalNormalForm l = a ↔
    l = Ordinal.CNF Ordinal.omega0 a
